format: YAML/Makefile-like syntax with embedded Python functions
description: This file is a Yocto Recipe Include (.inc) script designed to automate the packaging of GStreamer plugins. It dynamically generates individual packages for each plugin, manages dependencies, and creates a meta package aggregating them all. The script defines functions to split plugin components into separate packages and set appropriate runtime dependencies.

methods.name: split_gstreamer10_packages
methods.description: Dynamically creates individual packages for GStreamer libraries, plugins, typelib files, and static libraries by matching filename patterns and applying specific templates and descriptions.

methods.name: set_gstreamer10_metapkg_rdepends
methods.description: Sets runtime dependencies for the meta package by including all non-system, non-empty packages except for main and meta packages themselves.
